ux_bug_surfaced_and_fixed_within_substep.issue: /var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml is mode -rw------- root-readable only. Non-sudo cipher-platform status/verify shells out to cipher_cdi_patch.sh status which exits with PermissionError. Initial CLI logic reported applied=False marker=None (false negative); verify reported 'CDI patch not applied' (misleading - patch IS applied, status just can't read it).
ux_bug_surfaced_and_fixed_within_substep.fix: cipher_platform_cli.py _cdi_status() now checks os.access(CDI_PATH, os.R_OK) before shelling out; if not readable, returns {'applied': 'unknown', 'permission_denied': True, 'hint': '...root-readable only; re-run with sudo.'}. _cmd_verify treats permission_denied as a distinct failure mode with sudo-hint failure message.

post_fix_behavior.non_sudo_status: CDI patch: applied=unknown marker=None (clear that this is a read-permission state, not a substrate failure)

honest_residue: 1. .deb installed on the build pod itself (Lambda H100, Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 6.8.0-1046-nvidia). Verification on a CLEAN target node (no pre-installed v1.0) is deferred - the v1->v2 upgrade path was exercised here but a from-scratch install would surface different postinst paths (e.g., first DKMS add vs replace).

2. systemd path-watcher 'active' state verified, but the PathChanged trigger has not yet fired in this session (would require nvidia-ctk to regenerate nvidia.yaml; tested only via direct cipher_cdi_patch.sh apply at install time). Trigger behavior under real driver upgrade is implicit; B.3'' Gate E exercises this in a more realistic scenario.

3. cipher-platform-watch.service SuccessExitStatus=0 1 allows the service to NOT fail on rc=1 (e.g., transient nvidia.yaml-missing during regeneration). For ops monitoring, this means systemd alert thresholds need to be set against journal log content patterns, not service-failed state.
4. cipher-run backward-compat wrapper retained even though v2.0 deployment is CDI-driven. Could be removed in v2.x if CDI adoption is universal; carries 0 KB cost (712-byte script).

5. Verify subcommand verbose output mixes useful PASS/FAIL with substrate's own [cipher_v2] init prints (the ctypes.CDLL of libcipher_rt.so triggers substrate auto-init constructor which prints; harmless but noisy). Could redirect to /dev/null in v2.x; not blocking.

6. dpkg 'unable to delete old directory /usr/src/cipher-kmod-0.4.8' warning is benign carry-over from v1.0 era. Fresh installs from-scratch will not have this. Documented in install_verdict.dpkg_warning.

7. The .deb assumes target host has nvidia-container-toolkit-generated /var/run/cdi/nvidia.yaml at postinst time. On a host with NVIDIA driver but no nvidia-ctk cdi generate run, postinst will print a WARNING but install completes; first apply happens via systemd watcher once nvidia-ctk runs. Runbook §3.3 covers this path.
